people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

translations.web: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
translations.bsb: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”
translations.kjv: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
translations.asv: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
